canonical_project: Orange Tunisie Data Center Kalaa Kebira
notes: New Tier III next-generation data center at Kalaa Kebira (Sousse governorate), inaugurated 5 May 2025 by Orange Tunisie in presence of the Minister of Communication Technologies; ~1,000 m2 facility designed and built by Tunisian companies; serves Orange internal needs and B2B cloud/hosting services; connected to local fiber.
